fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2026-05-18, around 00:20, a message about KYC expiry led the complainant to a website where account credentials were entered, and Rs. 58,000 was transferred out, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-05-25. The online submission was made by Sanjay Raj (9000000083). The account reference SYN-ACC-100062 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. Mathan Raman (mobile 9000000187) was named as a possible person of interest. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Caller allegedly posed as a bank executive and asked for remote access.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, night, suspect, bank account, mobile number, college road
